clue.text: As a self-centred person, I get so confused

indicators.note: something confused is muddled up, so the letters before it are jumbled into a new order

blocks.note: the six letters taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone admits that their self-absorption leaves them muddled.
explanation.definitionFit: An egoist is a person preoccupied with their own interests, i.e. self-centred.

clue.text: Blockbuster blown away

blocks.note: first meaning: a huge hit film, here the 1939 epic
second meaning: literally carried off by a gust

explanation.walkthrough: The film title read literally describes something carried off by the breeze.
explanation.definitionFit: Gone with the Wind is one of the most successful films ever made, and the phrase literally means swept off by moving air.

clue.text: Shunned soldier turning up? No, Communist

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up means reading the word from bottom to top, so backwards

blocks.note: GI is an American soldier; it is reversed to IG
taken as written
red is the traditional colour, and nickname, of a Communist

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a soldier showing up was snubbed, and is told no, it was a Communist.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignore someone is to deliberately take no notice of them, which is the sense of shunned.

clue.text: Will that could be old or new?

definitions.text: that could be old or new

blocks.note: first meaning: a legal document disposing of property after death

blocks.clueFragment: that could be old or new
blocks.note: second meaning: either half of the Christian Bible, the Old or the New one

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second half, which points to the two divisions of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Last will and testament' is the formal legal phrase, and the Bible divides into Old and New Testaments.

clue.text: Good-looking worker gets part

blocks.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand
some means a portion or part of something

explanation.surface: An attractive employee lands a role, perhaps in a film.
explanation.definitionFit: Handsome describes someone attractive in appearance, a standard synonym for good-looking.

clue.text: Wanting food outside a country in Europe

indicators.note: outside says one word goes around another, enclosing it

blocks.note: wanting food means feeling hungry
taken as written

explanation.surface: A hungry traveller finds themselves out of reach of food somewhere in Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: The single letter A goes between the G and R of HUNGRY.
explanation.definitionFit: Hungary is a landlocked nation in central Europe, so it fits the description of a European country.

clue.text: Unprecedented work of fiction

blocks.note: first meaning: new and original, never seen before
second meaning: a long prose story

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it sounds like praise for a groundbreaking book; the two parts are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Novel as an adjective means strikingly new, and as a noun it is a book-length fictional narrative.

clue.text: Salesman's talk about a new dog

indicators.note: about means going around, so the talk wraps round the other letters

blocks.note: taken as written
N is the standard abbreviation for new
a spiel is a glib persuasive patter, typical of a salesman

explanation.surface: A salesperson gives a pitch about a new puppy for sale.
explanation.definitionFit: A spaniel is a breed of dog with long drooping ears, so it is an example of the definition.

clue.text: Queen, making nation irate, met guillotine, finally

indicators.note: making suggests the following letters are formed into something new, so they are rearranged
finally points to the last letter of the word just before it

blocks.note: fourteen letters taken as written
the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A queen who angered her country ended up beheaded: a neat summary of the French Revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue tells her story: the French queen enraged her people and was executed in 1793.
explanation.definitionFit: Marie Antoinette was the queen consort of Louis XVI of France, so she is an instance of a queen.

clue.text: One sister, one child — as one

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a nun is a religious sister
I is the Roman numeral one again
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: A list of family members rounded off with a call for unity.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in unison means doing something together simultaneously, just as acting as one does.

clue.text: In Scandinavia grandpa discovered potent drug

indicators.note: In tells you the answer sits inside the words that follow, spanning two of them

blocks.note: the run of letters across the end of the first word and the start of the second

explanation.surface: A grandfather in Scandinavia stumbles on a powerful medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discovered' links definition and wordplay, though it also hints at the letters being uncovered.
explanation.definitionFit: Viagra is a brand-name erectile-dysfunction drug, famously potent in the other sense of the word too.

clue.text: Female in the flock beginning to replenish jug

indicators.note: beginning to picks out only the first letter of the following word

blocks.note: a ewe is a female sheep
its opening letter

explanation.surface: A shepherd imagines a sheep helping to refill a water pitcher.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewer is a large wide-mouthed water jug, the kind once set in a basin on a washstand.

clue.text: Always a lofty newspaper

blocks.note: taken as written
lofty means high or tall
The Times is a British national newspaper

explanation.surface: A paper with lofty ideals, perhaps a broadsheet, is forever so.
explanation.definitionFit: Always and at all times both mean on every occasion without exception, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Unappetising food, for example, Dorothy's brought back

indicators.note: brought back means returned the way it came, so read from end to start

blocks.note: e.g. abbreviates exempli gratia, 'for example'
Dot is a short form of the name Dorothy
the possessive ending kept as a letter

explanation.surface: Dorothy has brought home leftovers that look unappealing.
explanation.definitionFit: Stodge is heavy, filling, starchy food, the kind one eats without much pleasure.

clue.text: Nigel Ray trained a young racehorse

indicators.note: trained means drilled into a new shape, so the letters are reworked

blocks.note: the letters of the name taken as written

explanation.surface: A trainer called Nigel Ray schooled a juvenile horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A yearling is a racehorse in its first year after the January 1 following its birth, so a young one.

clue.text: Area left in one country or another

indicators.note: in says these letters are placed inside the word that follows

blocks.note: A is the usual abbreviation for area
L is the abbreviation for left
one country, a European republic

explanation.surface: Someone muses that a region lies within one nation or other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' is the definition, meaning another country: the answer is a second nation built from the first, whose name differs by just two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Australia is a different nation from Austria, so it is 'another' country, read on from the earlier mention.

clue.text: National Trust island in collection of maps is long-lost land

indicators.note: in places the preceding letters inside the word for a map book

blocks.note: NT is the abbreviation for the National Trust, the British heritage charity
I is a standard abbreviation for island
an atlas is a bound book of maps

explanation.surface: A heritage-body island turns up in an atlas and proves to be a vanished country.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlantis is the legendary island civilisation said by Plato to have sunk beneath the sea, a land lost long ago.

clue.text: A Tibetan monk with a bishop in a US state

indicators.note: in says the bishop group is placed within the other letters

blocks.note: taken as written
a lama is a Buddhist monk of Tibet
taken as written
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A Tibetan monk and a bishop turn up together somewhere in America.
explanation.walkthrough: The bishop pair goes inside the word made by the first A and the monk, straight after its second letter, not around the whole thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabama is one of the southern states of the USA, so it is an example of the definition.

clue.text: Stealthily pursued, son divulged information

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for son
a person who talked gave away secrets

explanation.surface: A boy who was being followed eventually gave up what he knew.
explanation.definitionFit: To stalk is to follow quietly and secretly, as a hunter or a pursuer does.

clue.text: Time to add salt and pepper?

blocks.note: first meaning: a period of the year, such as summer
second meaning: to flavour food

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark makes it look like a cook asking when to flavour a dish; 'Time' is a separate meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: A season is a division of the year, and to season food is to flavour it with condiments.

clue.text: Everyone was in debt, but that's permissible

blocks.note: all means everyone
a party that owed money was in debt

explanation.surface: Everybody owed money, yet it was all quite legal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something allowed is permitted by the rules, which is what permissible means.

clue.text: Doctor and cashier getting old form of transport

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are altered in order

blocks.note: ten letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A doctor and a bank teller are carried off in a vintage vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a person beside the cashier, but it is a verb telling you to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A sedan chair was an enclosed seat carried on poles by two bearers, a way of travelling in the 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: In the centre of San Francisco, Michael Palin's amusing

indicators.note: the centre of the phrase holds the letters, buried in the middle of the words

blocks.note: the run of letters across the end of the city's name and the start of the first name

explanation.surface: Michael Palin, Monty Python performer, proves funny in the heart of San Francisco.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters straddle the comma between the city and the first name; 'Palin's' completes the surface, and Palin is himself a comedian.
explanation.definitionFit: Comic as an adjective means funny or causing laughter, the same as amusing.

clue.text: Connections, we hear, for wild cat

indicators.note: we hear says the word is identified by how it is spoken rather than spelt

blocks.note: links are connections, and the word is pronounced identically to the cat

explanation.surface: We are told about some ties to a feral feline.
explanation.definitionFit: A lynx is a wild cat with tufted ears and a short tail, found in forests of the northern hemisphere.

clue.text: Take weapons from leader of militia after fresh raids

indicators.note: fresh means new, so the letters are made into a new arrangement
the leader of a word is its first letter
after says this letter is placed following the other piece

blocks.note: taken as written
its opening letter

explanation.surface: After new attacks, the authorities move to strip a militia commander of arms.
explanation.definitionFit: To disarm someone is to remove their weapons, so it is a direct synonym of the phrase.

clue.text: Talk to WI about measure of power

indicators.note: about here means around and about, scattered, so the letters are moved around

blocks.note: eight letters taken as written; the WI is the Women's Institute, a British community organisation

explanation.surface: An invitation to address the Women's Institute, a British community group, on electricity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like it means 'on the subject of', but it is telling you to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A kilowatt is a unit of power equal to a thousand watts, so it is one way of measuring it.

clue.text: Lent may be brought forward

blocks.note: first meaning: given as a loan, as money is
second meaning: moved earlier or further on

explanation.walkthrough: The capital L makes 'Lent' look like the church season before Easter, but it is the past tense of lend.
explanation.definitionFit: Money advanced is money lent ahead of time, and a date advanced has been moved earlier.

clue.text: Article sketched for patron saint

blocks.note: an is the indefinite article
drew is the past tense of draw, to sketch

explanation.surface: Someone drafted a piece of writing in honour of a holy protector.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Andrew is the patron saint of Scotland, so he is one example of the definition.
